title.zh: 卷一百十二 列傳第五十: 完顏合達 移剌蒲阿
title.en: Volume 112 Biographies 50: Wanyan Heda, Yi Lapua
title.raw: 卷一百十二 列傳第五十: 完顏合達 移剌蒲阿 Volume 112 Biographies 50: Wanyan Heda, Yi Lapua

sentences.zh: 完顏合達

translations.literal: Wanyan Heda
translations.idiomatic: Biography: Wanyan Heda

sentences.zh: 完顏合達，名瞻，字景山。

translations.literal: Wanyan Heda, whose personal name was Zhan, whose style name was Jingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Heda, personal name Zhan, style name Jingshan.

sentences.zh: 少長兵間，習弓馬，能得人死力。

translations.literal: From youth he grew up amid armies, trained in archery and horsemanship, and could obtain people's utmost devoted effort.
translations.idiomatic: He grew up in the military from childhood, mastered archery and horsemanship, and could inspire men to fight to the death for him.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，以親衛軍送岐國公主，充護衛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhenyou reign, as an imperial guard he escorted the Princess of Qi State and served as her protector.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhenyou era he served in the imperial guard escorting the Princess of Qi and acted as her protector.

sentences.zh: 三年，授臨潢府推官，權元帥右監軍。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed investigating censor of Linhuang Prefecture and acted as right deputy army supervisor under the marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In year three he received appointment as Linhuang Prefecture investigating censor and provisional right deputy army supervisor under the marshal.

sentences.zh: 時臨潢避遷，與全、慶兩州之民共壁平州。

translations.literal: At the time Linhuang had relocated to avoid danger, and together with the people of Quan and Qing prefectures they jointly defended Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Linhuang had relocated for safety, and its people joined those of Quan and Qing prefectures in pooling their defenses at Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 合達隸其經略使烏林答乞住，乞住以便宜授軍中都統，累遷提控，佩金符。

translations.literal: Heda was under its frontier commissioner Wulind Qizhu; Qizhu according to emergency authority appointed him military commandant within the army, and he was repeatedly promoted to army controller and wore the gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: Heda served under frontier commissioner Wulind Qizhu, who by emergency authority made him a military commandant in the army; he rose through successive promotions to army controller and was awarded the gold tally.

sentences.zh: 未幾，會燕南諸帥將兵複中都城，行至平州遷安縣，臨潢、全慶兩軍變，殺乞住，擁合達還平州，推為帥，統乞住軍。

translations.literal: Before long, when the commanders of southern Yan assembled troops to recover the Central Capital, as they reached Qian'an County in Pingzhou the Linhuang and Quan-Qing armies mutinied, killed Qizhu, escorted Heda back to Pingzhou, made him commander, and put Qizhu's army under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the southern Yan commanders mustered troops to retake the Central Capital; when they reached Qian'an County in Pingzhou, the Linhuang and Quan-Qing forces mutinied, killed Qizhu, brought Heda back to Pingzhou, and made him commander over Qizhu's former army.

sentences.zh: 合達以計誅首亂者數人。

translations.literal: Heda by stratagem executed several ringleaders of the mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: Heda used a ruse to execute several of the mutiny's ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 其年六月，北兵大將喊得不遣監戰提軍至平州城下，以州人黃裳入城招降，父老不從，合達引兵逆戰，知事勢不敵，以本軍降於陣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of that year the northern army's great general Handebud sent a battle supervisor with troops to the walls of Pingzhou; he sent a local man named Huang Shang into the city to summon surrender, but the elders would not comply; Heda led troops out to meet them in battle, saw that the situation was not equal, and surrendered his army on the field.
translations.idiomatic: That June the northern general Handebud sent a battle supervisor with troops to Pingzhou; a local man named Huang Shang was sent into the city to offer terms, but the elders refused. Heda marched out to fight, saw he was outmatched, and surrendered his army on the spot.

sentences.zh: 監戰以合達北上，留半發，令還守平州。

translations.literal: The battle supervisor took Heda north, left Banfa, and ordered him to return and hold Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The battle supervisor took Heda north, left Banfa behind, and ordered Heda to return and hold Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 已而，謀自拔歸，乃遣奉先縣令紇石烈布裏哥、北京教授蒲察胡裏安、右三部檢法蒲察蒲女涉海來報。

translations.literal: Before long, planning to break free and return to the Jin, he sent Fengxian magistrate Heshenlie Bulige, Bejing instructor Pucha Hulian, and Right Three Departments inspector Pucha Punü across the sea to report.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, plotting to escape and return to Jin territory, he sent Fengxian magistrate Heshenlie Bulige, Bejing instructor Pucha Hulian, and Right Three Departments inspector Pucha Punü across the sea to bring word.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月，合達果率所部及州民並海西南歸國。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year Heda indeed led his command and the people of the prefecture along the coast southwest back to the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year four Heda did lead his troops and the prefecture's people along the coast southwest back to Jin territory.

sentences.zh: 詔進官三階，升鎮南軍節度使，駐益都，與元帥蒙古綱相應接，充宣差都提控。

translations.literal: An edict advanced his rank by three steps, promoted him to military commissioner of the Zhennan Army, stationed him at Yidu, had him coordinate with Marshal Menggugang, and appointed him special commissioner and overall army controller.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted three ranks by edict, made military commissioner of the Zhennan Army, and stationed at Yidu to coordinate with Marshal Menggugang as special commissioner and overall army controller.

sentences.zh: 十二月，大元兵徇地博興、樂安、壽光，東涉濰州之境，蒙古綱遣合達率兵屢戰于壽光、臨淄。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Great Yuan army raided Boxing, Le'an, and Shouguang, and marched east into the territory of Wei Prefecture; Menggugang sent Heda to lead troops and fight repeatedly at Shouguang and Linzi.
translations.idiomatic: In December the Great Yuan army overran Boxing, Le'an, and Shouguang and pushed east into Wei Prefecture; Menggugang dispatched Heda, who fought repeated engagements at Shouguang and Linzi.

sentences.zh: 興定元年正月，轉通遠軍節度使、兼鞏州管內觀察使。

translations.literal: In the first month of Xingding 1 he was transferred to military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army and concurrently observation commissioner within Gong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Xingding 1 he was transferred to military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army and concurrent observation commissioner for Gong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七月，改平西軍節度使、兼河州管內觀察使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was changed to military commissioner of the Pingxi Army and concurrently observation commissioner within He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was reassigned as military commissioner of the Pingxi Army and concurrent observation commissioner for He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，知延安府事、兼鄜延路兵馬都總管。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 2 he was made prefect of Yan'an and concurrently overall commander of troops and horses on the Fuyan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 2 he was appointed prefect of Yan'an and concurrent overall commander of troops and horses on the Fuyan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，詔伐宋，以合達為元帥右都監。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 3 an edict ordered an attack on Song, and Heda was made right deputy army supervisor under the marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 3 an edict ordered war on Song, and Heda was appointed right deputy army supervisor under the marshal.

sentences.zh: 三月，破宋兵于梅林關，擒統領張時。

translations.literal: In the third month he defeated Song troops at Meilin Pass and captured the commander Zhang Shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he routed Song forces at Meilin Pass and captured the commander Zhang Shi.

sentences.zh: 又敗宋兵于馬嶺堡，獲馬百匹。

translations.literal: He again defeated Song troops at Maling Fort and captured a hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: He again defeated Song troops at Maling Fort and seized a hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 又拔麻城縣，獲其令張倜、幹辦官郭守紀。

translations.literal: He also took Macheng County and captured its magistrate Zhang Ti and staff officer Guo Shouji.
translations.idiomatic: He also captured Macheng County along with its magistrate Zhang Ti and staff officer Guo Shouji.

sentences.zh: 四月，夏人犯通秦寨，合達出兵安塞堡，抵隆州，夏人自城中出步騎二千逆戰，進兵擊之，斬首數十級，俘十人，遂攻隆州，陷其西南隅，會日暮乃還。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the Xia people attacked Tongqin Stockade; Heda led troops out from Ansaibao and reached Long Prefecture; the Xia sent two thousand infantry and cavalry out from the city to meet him in battle; he advanced and struck them, beheaded several tens, captured ten men, then attacked Long Prefecture and breached its southwest corner, but returned when night fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Tangut forces attacked Tongqin Stockade; Heda marched from Ansaibao to Long Prefecture. The Tanguts sent two thousand foot and horse soldiers out to meet him; he attacked, took several dozen heads and ten prisoners, then assaulted Long Prefecture and broke through its southwest corner before withdrawing at dusk.

sentences.zh: 六月，行元帥府事于唐、鄧，上遣諭曰：「以卿才幹，故委卿，無使敵人侵軼，第固吾圉可也。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he conducted the affairs of the marshal's headquarters at Tang and Deng; the emperor sent word saying: "Because of your talent and ability I have entrusted you; do not let the enemy raid across the border—simply hold our frontier firm."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he handled marshal headquarters affairs at Tang and Deng; the emperor sent word: "I have entrusted you because of your ability. Do not let the enemy raid across our borders—simply hold the frontier firm."

sentences.zh: 」四年正月，複為元帥右都監，屯延安。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 4 he again became right deputy army supervisor under the marshal and encamped at Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 4 he was again made right deputy army supervisor under the marshal and encamped at Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 十月，夏人攻綏德州，駐兵於拄天山。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Xia people attacked Sui Prefecture and encamped on Zhutian Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Tangut forces attacked Sui Prefecture and encamped on Zhutian Mountain.

sentences.zh: 合達將兵擊之，別遣先鋒提控樊澤等各率所部分三道以進，畢會於山顛。

translations.literal: Heda led troops to strike them, and separately sent vanguard army controller Fan Ze and others each to lead their units in three columns to advance, all assembling at the mountain summit.
translations.idiomatic: Heda led troops to attack them and separately dispatched vanguard army controller Fan Ze and others, each leading his unit in one of three columns, all converging at the mountaintop.

sentences.zh: 見夏人數萬余傅山而陣，即縱兵分擊。

translations.literal: Seeing more than ten thousand Xia people spread along the mountain in battle formation, he immediately released his troops to attack in separate groups.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing more than ten thousand Tangut soldiers arrayed along the mountainside, he at once sent his forces to attack in separate groups.

sentences.zh: 澤先登，摧其左軍，諸將繼攻其右，敗之。

translations.literal: Fan Ze climbed first, smashed their left army, and the generals then continued attacking their right and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ze reached the heights first and broke their left wing; the other generals then pressed their right and routed them.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，知延安府事，兼前職。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of year 5 he was made prefect of Yan'an while retaining his previous posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 5 he was appointed prefect of Yan'an while retaining his previous posts.

sentences.zh: 上言：「諸軍官以屢徙，故往往不知所居地形迂直險易，緩急之際恐至敗事，自今乞勿徙。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial saying: "Because military officers are frequently transferred, they often do not know whether the terrain where they are posted is winding or straight, easy or difficult; in an emergency this may lead to defeat—from now on I beg that they not be transferred."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Military officers are transferred so often that they often do not know the terrain of their posts—whether it is winding or straight, easy or difficult—and in a crisis this can lead to defeat. Hereafter I ask that they not be moved."

sentences.zh: 」又言：「河南、陝西鎮防軍皆分屯諸路，在營惟老稚而已。

translations.literal: He also said: "The garrison-defense armies of Henan and Shaanxi are all dispersed to garrison the various circuits, and in camp there are only the old and the young."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "The garrison-defense armies of Henan and Shaanxi are scattered across the circuits, and in camp there are only the old and the young."

sentences.zh: 乞選老成人為各路統軍以鎮撫之，且督其子弟習騎射，將來可用。

translations.literal: I beg that mature men be selected as circuit commanders for each circuit to pacify and control them, and also supervise their sons and younger brothers in practicing mounted archery so they may be useful in the future.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that experienced men be chosen as circuit commanders to keep order in each circuit and supervise their sons and younger brothers in mounted archery so they will be ready when needed.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All of this was approved.

sentences.zh: 十一月，夏人攻安塞堡，其軍先至，合達與征行元帥納合買住禦之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Xia people attacked Ansaibao; their army arrived first, and Heda together with campaign marshal Nahan Maizhu defended against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Tangut forces attacked Ansaibao; their army arrived first, and Heda joined campaign marshal Nahan Maizhu in the defense.

sentences.zh: 合達策之曰：「比北方兵至，先破夏人則後易為力。

translations.literal: Heda planned and said: "Before the northern army arrives, if we first defeat the Xia people the rest will be easier."
translations.idiomatic: Heda devised a plan: "Before the northern army arrives, if we break the Tanguts first the rest will be easier."

sentences.zh: 」於是潛軍裹糧倍道兼進，夜襲其營，夏人果大潰，追殺四十裏，墜崖谷死者不可勝計。

translations.literal: Thereupon he secretly moved troops carrying rations, marched by forced marches on double routes, and raided their camp by night; the Xia people indeed collapsed in great disorder; they were pursued and killed for forty li, and those who fell from cliffs and ravines and died were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: He then secretly marched troops loaded with rations by forced double marches and raided their camp at night; the Tangut army broke in rout, was pursued for forty li, and countless men fell to their deaths in cliffs and ravines.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，賜金各五十兩、重幣十端，且詔諭曰：「卿等克成大功，朕聞之良喜。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it he bestowed fifty taels of gold each and ten bolts of heavy silk, and also issued an edict saying: "You have achieved a great victory; I am truly delighted to hear it."
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it he rewarded each man with fifty taels of gold and ten bolts of heavy silk, and issued an edict: "You have won a great victory, and I am truly delighted."

sentences.zh: 經畫如此，彼當知畏，期之數年，卿等可以休息矣。

translations.literal: With planning like this they should know fear; within a few years you should be able to rest.
translations.idiomatic: With planning like this they should learn to fear us; in a few years you should be able to rest."

sentences.zh: 」仍詔以合達之功遍諭河南帥臣。

translations.literal: An edict was also issued to announce Heda's achievement throughout to the commanders of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was also issued announcing Heda's achievement to all the commanders of Henan.

sentences.zh: 是月，與元帥買住又戰延安，皆被重創。

translations.literal: That month he again fought at Yan'an together with Marshal Maizhu, and both suffered serious wounds.
translations.idiomatic: That month he fought again at Yan'an alongside Marshal Maizhu, and both were seriously wounded.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以保延安功賜金帶一、玉吐鶻一，重幣十端。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, for the merit of preserving Yan'an he was granted one gold belt, one jade gyrfalcon plaque, and ten bolts of heavy silk.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, for preserving Yan'an he was granted a gold belt, a jade gyrfalcon plaque, and ten bolts of heavy silk.

sentences.zh: 葭州提控王公佐言於合達曰：「去歲十月，北兵既破葭州，構浮梁河上。

translations.literal: Jia Prefecture army controller Wang Gongzuo said to Heda: "Last year in the tenth month, after the northern army had taken Jia Prefecture, they built a pontoon bridge across the river."
translations.idiomatic: Jia Prefecture army controller Wang Gongzuo told Heda: "Last October, after the northern army took Jia Prefecture, they built a pontoon bridge across the river."

sentences.zh: 公佐寓州治北石山子，招集餘眾得二千餘人，欲複州城。

translations.literal: Gongzuo lodged at Beishishanzi north of the prefectural seat, gathered the remaining troops to more than two thousand men, and wished to recover the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: Gongzuo made camp at Beishishanzi north of the prefectural seat, gathered more than two thousand survivors, and hoped to retake the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 以士卒皆自北逃歸者，且無鎧仗，故嘗請兵于帥府，將焚其浮橋，以取葭州，帥府不聽。

translations.literal: Because the soldiers were all men who had fled back from the north and had no armor or weapons, he had requested troops from the marshal's headquarters intending to burn their pontoon bridge and retake Jia Prefecture, but the headquarters would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: His soldiers were all men who had fled south from the north and had no armor or weapons; he had asked headquarters for troops to burn the pontoon bridge and retake Jia Prefecture, but headquarters refused.

sentences.zh: 又請兵援護老幼稍徙內地，而帥府亦不應。

translations.literal: He also requested troops to escort the old and young and gradually move them inland, but the headquarters again did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for troops to escort the old and young inland, but headquarters again did not respond.

sentences.zh: 今葭州之民迫於敵境，皆有動搖之心。

translations.literal: Now the people of Jia Prefecture, pressed by the enemy border, all have wavering hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Now the people of Jia Prefecture, pressed against the enemy frontier, are all losing heart.

sentences.zh: 若是秋敵騎複來，則公佐力屈死于敵手，而遺民亦俱屠矣。

translations.literal: If this autumn the enemy cavalry come again, then Gongzuo's strength will be exhausted and he will die at the enemy's hands, and the remaining people will also all be slaughtered.
translations.idiomatic: If enemy cavalry return this autumn, Gongzuo's strength will give out and he will die at their hands, and the surviving people will be slaughtered as well."

sentences.zh: 」合達乃上言：「臣願馳至延安，與元帥買住議，以兵護公佐軍民來屯吳堡，伺隙而動。

translations.literal: Heda then submitted a memorial saying: "Your subject wishes to ride swiftly to Yan'an and consult with Marshal Maizhu to use troops to escort Gongzuo's soldiers and people to encamp at Wubao and wait for an opening to act."
translations.idiomatic: Heda then memorialized: "Your subject wishes to ride at once to Yan'an and consult with Marshal Maizhu about using troops to escort Gongzuo's soldiers and civilians to Wubao and waiting for an opportunity to strike."

sentences.zh: 」詔省院議之，於是命合達率兵取葭州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Secretariat and the Censorate to deliberate, and thereupon Heda was ordered to lead troops to retake Jia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered the Secretariat and Censorate to deliberate, and Heda was then ordered to lead troops to retake Jia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 行至鄜州，千戶張子政等殺萬戶陳紋，將掠城中。

translations.literal: When he reached Fu Prefecture, thousand-household chief Zhang Zizheng and others killed ten-thousand-household chief Chen Wen and were about to plunder the city.
translations.idiomatic: At Fu Prefecture, chiliarch Zhang Zizheng and his men killed myriarch Chen Wen and were about to sack the town.

sentences.zh: 合達已勒兵為備，子政等乃出城走，合達追及之，眾複來歸，斬首惡數十人，軍乃定。

translations.literal: Heda had already drawn up troops in readiness; Zizheng and the others then fled out of the city; Heda pursued and caught them, the troops returned again, several tens of ringleaders were beheaded, and the army was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Heda had already drawn up his troops in readiness; Zizheng and the others fled the city, but Heda overtook them, the men returned to the ranks, several dozen ringleaders were beheaded, and the army was restored to order.

sentences.zh: 六月，合達上言：「累獲諜者，皆雲北方已約夏人，將由河中、葭州以入陝西。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Heda submitted a memorial saying: "We have repeatedly captured spies, all of whom say the north has already made an agreement with the Xia people and will enter Shaanxi by way of Hezhong and Jia Prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Heda memorialized: "We have repeatedly captured spies, all reporting that the north has already made terms with the Tanguts and will enter Shaanxi by way of Hezhong and Jia Prefecture."

sentences.zh: 防秋在近，宜預為計。

translations.literal: Autumn defense is near; we should plan ahead.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn defense is near, and we should plan ahead."

sentences.zh: 今陝西重兵兩行省分制之，然京兆抵平涼六百余裏，萬一敵梗其間，，使不得通，是自孤也。

translations.literal: Now the heavy troops of Shaanxi are divided and controlled by two branch secretariats, yet from Jingzhao to Pingliang is more than six hundred li; if by chance the enemy blocks the route between them so they cannot communicate, that is to isolate oneself.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi's main forces are now split between two branch secretariats, yet Jingzhao is more than six hundred li from Pingliang; if the enemy blocks the route between them and cuts off communication, we isolate ourselves.

sentences.zh: 宜令平涼行省內族白撒領軍東下，與臣協力禦敵，以屏潼、陝，敵退後復議分司為便。

translations.literal: It would be appropriate to order the Pingliang branch secretariat's imperial clansman Ba Sa to lead troops eastward and join with me in concerted defense against the enemy to shield Tong and Shaan; after the enemy withdraws we can again discuss dividing the offices as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The Pingliang branch secretariat's imperial clansman Ba Sa should be ordered to lead troops east and join me in a coordinated defense to shield Tong and Shaan; after the enemy withdraws we can revisit the question of dividing the offices.

sentences.zh: 」詔許之。

translations.literal: An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved this.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，以保鳳翔之功進官，賜金幣及通犀帶一。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 2, for the merit of preserving Fengxiang he was promoted in rank and granted gold coins and one rhinoceros-horn belt.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 2, for preserving Fengxiang he was promoted in rank and granted gold coins and a rhinoceros-horn belt.

sentences.zh: 是時，河中已破，合達提兵複取之。

translations.literal: At that time Hezhong had already fallen; Heda led troops and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: By then Hezhong had fallen, and Heda led troops to retake it.

sentences.zh: 正大二年七月，陝西旱甚，合達齋戒請雨，雨澍，是歲大稔，民立石頌德。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Zhengda 2 Shaanxi suffered severe drought; Heda fasted and prayed for rain; rain fell abundantly; that year there was a great harvest, and the people erected a stone to praise his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Zhengda 2 Shaanxi suffered severe drought; Heda fasted and prayed for rain, rain fell in abundance, the year brought a great harvest, and the people erected a stone monument in praise of his virtue.

sentences.zh: 延安既殘毀，合達令于西路買牛付主者，招集散亡，助其耕墾，自是延安之民稍複耕稼之利。

translations.literal: Since Yan'an had been ravaged and destroyed, Heda ordered cattle to be purchased on the western route and entrusted to household heads, gathered the scattered and displaced, and helped them in plowing and reclaiming land; from this time the people of Yan'an gradually recovered the benefits of farming.
translations.idiomatic: Yan'an lay in ruins; Heda ordered cattle purchased on the western route and entrusted to household heads, gathered the scattered and displaced, and helped them reclaim land for farming, so that the people of Yan'an gradually recovered the benefits of agriculture.

sentences.zh: 八月，鞏州田瑞反，合達討之，諸軍進攻，合達移文諭之曰：「罪止田瑞一身，餘無所問。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Tian Rui of Gong Prefecture rebelled; Heda suppressed him; the armies advanced to attack; Heda sent a written proclamation saying: "Guilt rests on Tian Rui alone; the rest will not be questioned."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Tian Rui of Gong Prefecture rebelled; Heda marched against him, and as the armies pressed the attack he issued a proclamation: "Guilt rests on Tian Rui alone; no one else will be questioned."

sentences.zh: 」不數日，瑞弟濟殺瑞以降，合達如約撫定一州，民賴以寧。

translations.literal: Within a few days Rui's younger brother Ji killed Rui and surrendered; Heda according to his promise pacified and settled the whole prefecture, and the people relied on this for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few days Rui's younger brother Ji killed him and surrendered; Heda kept his word and pacified the whole prefecture, and the people were restored to peace.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔遷平涼行省。

translations.literal: In year 3 an edict transferred him to the Pingliang branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In year three he was transferred by edict to the Pingliang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，征還，拜平章政事，芮國公。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 4 he was recalled and appointed chief councilor of the Secretariat and Duke of Rui State.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 4 he was recalled to court, appointed chief councilor of the Secretariat, and enfeoffed as Duke of Rui.

sentences.zh: 七年七月庚寅朔，以平章政事妨職樞密副使。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month of year 7, the gengyin day, he was removed from the post of chief councilor of the Secretariat and made vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the first gengyin day of the seventh month of year 7 he was removed from the chief councilor post and made vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 初，蒲阿面奏：「合達在軍中久，今日多事之際乃在於省，用違其長。

translations.literal: Earlier, Pu'a had memorialized in person saying: "Heda has long been in the army; at today's time of many crises he is in the Secretariat—this use goes against his strengths."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Pu'a had memorialized in person: "Heda has spent years in the field; at this crisis moment he sits in the Secretariat—this misuses his strengths."

sentences.zh: 臣等欲與樞密協力軍務，擢之相位似亦未晚。

translations.literal: Your subjects wish to join with the Bureau of Military Affairs in concerted effort on military affairs; promoting him to chief councilor would not seem too late.
translations.idiomatic: We wish to join the Bureau of Military Affairs in handling military affairs; promoting him to chief councilor can wait."

sentences.zh: 」故有此授。

translations.literal: Therefore there was this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Hence this appointment.

sentences.zh: 十月己未朔，詔合達及樞密副使蒲阿救衛州。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month, the jiwei day, an edict ordered Heda and vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Pu'a to rescue Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the first jiwei day of the tenth month an edict ordered Heda and vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Pu'a to relieve Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 初，朝廷以恆山公仙屯衛州，公府節制不一，欲合而一之。

translations.literal: Earlier the court had stationed Duke of Hengshan Xian at Weizhou; the ducal headquarters and the prefectural government were not under unified command, and it wished to combine them into one.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the court had stationed Duke of Hengshan Xian at Weizhou; the ducal headquarters and the prefectural government lacked unified command, and the court wished to merge them.

sentences.zh: 至是，河朔諸軍圍衛，內外不通已連月，但見塔上時舉火而已。

translations.literal: By this time the armies of north of the Yellow River had besieged Wei; inside and outside had been cut off for consecutive months, and one could only see signal fires raised on the tower from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: By then the armies north of the Yellow River had besieged Wei; inside and outside had been cut off for months, and one could only see signal fires raised on the tower from time to time.

sentences.zh: 合達等既至，先以親衛兵三千嘗之，北兵小退，翼日圍解。

translations.literal: After Heda and the others arrived, they first used three thousand imperial guards to test the enemy; the northern army retreated slightly, and the next day the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: When Heda and his force arrived, they first sent three thousand imperial guards to probe the enemy; the northern army fell back slightly, and the siege was lifted the next day.

sentences.zh: 上登承天門犒軍，皆授世襲謀克，賜良馬玉帶，全給月俸本色，蓋異恩也。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended Chengtian Gate to reward the army; all were granted hereditary company commanderships, given fine horses and jade belts, and paid their full monthly salaries in kind—this was extraordinary favor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended Chengtian Gate to reward the army; all were granted hereditary company commanderships, given fine horses and jade belts, and paid their full monthly salaries in kind—an extraordinary mark of favor.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以蒲阿權參和政事，同合達行省事於閿鄉，以備潼關。

translations.literal: Before long Pu'a was made acting participant in the administration of the Secretariat and together with Heda conducted branch secretariat affairs at Wenxiang to prepare for Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Pu'a was made acting participant in the Secretariat and joined Heda in handling branch secretariat affairs at Wenxiang to prepare the defense of Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 先是，陝省言備禦策，朝官集議，上策親征，中策幸陝，下策棄秦保潼關。

translations.literal: Earlier the Shaanxi branch secretariat had presented defense plans; court officials assembled to deliberate: the best plan was for the emperor to campaign in person, the middle plan was to visit Shaanxi, and the worst plan was to abandon Qin and hold only Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Shaanxi branch secretariat had submitted defense plans; court officials met to debate them: the best plan was for the emperor to take the field in person, the middle plan was to move the court to Shaanxi, and the worst was to abandon Qin and hold only Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 議者謂止可助陝西軍以決一戰，使陝西不守，河南亦不可保。

translations.literal: Those deliberating said that one could only assist the Shaanxi army to fight a decisive battle; if Shaanxi were not held, Henan also could not be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Those deliberating argued that the only option was to reinforce the Shaanxi army for a decisive battle; if Shaanxi could not be held, Henan could not be saved either.

sentences.zh: 至是，自陝以西亦不守矣。

translations.literal: By this time even west of Shaanxi could no longer be held.
translations.idiomatic: By then even the territory west of Shaanxi could no longer be held.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，北帥速不泬攻破小關，殘盧氏、硃陽，散漫百餘里間。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 8 the northern commander Subutai broke through Xiaoguan, ravaged Lushi and Zhuyang, and spread destruction over more than a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year eight the Mongol commander Subutai broke Xiaoguan, ravaged Lushi and Zhuyang, and laid waste to more than a hundred li of countryside.

sentences.zh: 潼關總帥納合買住率夾穀移迪烈、都尉高英拒之，求救地二省。

translations.literal: Tong Pass overall commander Nahan Maizhu led Jiagu Yidilie and commandant Gao Ying to resist them and requested relief from the two branch secretariats.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Pass overall commander Nahan Maizhu led Jiagu Yidilie and commandant Gao Ying to resist them and sent to both branch secretariats for relief.

sentences.zh: 省以陳和尚忠孝軍一千，都尉夾穀澤軍一萬往應，北軍退，追至穀口而還。

translations.literal: The branch secretariat sent Chen Heshang with one thousand Zhongxiao Army troops and commandant Jiagu Ze with ten thousand troops to respond; the northern army retreated, and they pursued to the mouth of the valley and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The branch secretariat sent Chen Heshang with one thousand Zhongxiao Army troops and commandant Jiagu Ze with ten thousand men in response; the northern army withdrew, and they pursued to the valley mouth before turning back.

sentences.zh: 兩省輒稱大捷，以聞。

translations.literal: The two branch secretariats promptly reported a great victory to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Both secretariats at once reported a great victory to court.

sentences.zh: 既而北軍攻風翔，二省提兵出關二十裏，與渭北軍交，至晚複收兵入關，鳳翔遂破。

translations.literal: Before long the northern army attacked Fengxiang; the two branch secretariats led troops twenty li out of the pass, engaged the army north of the Wei River, and by evening withdrew back into the pass; Fengxiang then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the northern army attacked Fengxiang; the two branch secretariats led troops twenty li beyond the pass, fought the army north of the Wei River, and by evening withdrew back inside the pass; Fengxiang then fell.

sentences.zh: 二省遂棄京兆，與牙古塔起遷居民于河南，留慶山奴守之。

translations.literal: The two branch secretariats then abandoned Jingzhao, and together with Yaguta moved the residents to Henan, leaving Qingshan Nu to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: The two branch secretariats then abandoned Jingzhao, and together with Yaguta moved the residents to Henan, leaving Qingshan Nu to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 九月，北兵入河中，時二相防秋還陝，量以軍馬出冷水穀以為聲援。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the northern army entered Hezhong; at the time the two chief councilors had returned to Shaanxi after autumn defense and sent a limited force of troops and horses out from Lengshuigu to serve as a supporting demonstration.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the northern army entered Hezhong; the two chief councilors had returned to Shaanxi after autumn defense and sent a limited force through Lengshuigu as a show of support.

sentences.zh: 十一月，鄧州報，北兵道饒峰關，由金州而東。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Deng Prefecture reported that the northern army was taking the route through Raofeng Pass and marching east from Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Deng Prefecture reported that the northern army was coming by Raofeng Pass and marching east from Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 於是，兩省軍入鄧，遣提控劉天山以劄付下襄陽制置司，約同禦北兵，且索軍食。

translations.literal: Thereupon the armies of the two branch secretariats entered Deng and dispatched army controller Liu Tianshan with a letter to the Xiangyang pacification commission, proposing to resist the northern army together and also requesting military provisions.
translations.idiomatic: The armies of both branch secretariats then entered Deng and dispatched army controller Liu Tianshan with a letter to the Xiangyang pacification commission, proposing joint resistance against the northern army and requesting military provisions.

sentences.zh: 兩省以前月癸卯行，留楊沃衍軍守閿鄉。

translations.literal: The two branch secretariats had set out on the guimao day of the previous month and left Yang Woyan's army to hold Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: The two branch secretariats had set out on the guimao day of the previous month, leaving Yang Woyan's army to hold Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 沃衍尋被旨取洛南路入商州，屯豐陽川備上津，與恆山公仙相掎角。

translations.literal: Woyan soon received orders to take the Luonan route into Shang Prefecture, encamp at Fengyangchuan to prepare for Shangjin, and coordinate with Duke of Hengshan Xian in a pincer formation.
translations.idiomatic: Woyan soon received orders to take the Luonan route into Shang Prefecture, encamp at Fengyangchuan to guard Shangjin, and coordinate with Duke of Hengshan Xian in a pincer.

sentences.zh: 合達複留禦侮中郎將完顏陳和尚于閿鄉南十五裏，乃行。

translations.literal: Heda again left Defensive Honorific General Wanyan Chen Heshang fifteen li south of Wenxiang and then set out.
translations.idiomatic: Heda again left Defensive Honorific General Wanyan Chen Heshang fifteen li south of Wenxiang and then marched on.

sentences.zh: 陳和尚亦隨而往。

translations.literal: Chen Heshang also followed and went along.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Heshang followed as well.

sentences.zh: 沃衍軍八千及商州之木瓜平，一日夜馳三百里入桃花堡，知北兵由豐陽而東，亦東還，會大軍于鎮平。

translations.literal: Woyan's eight thousand troops and those of Mugua Plain in Shang Prefecture raced three hundred li in one day and night into Taohuabao; learning that the northern army was going east from Fengyang, they also turned east and joined the main army at Zhenping.
translations.idiomatic: Woyan's eight thousand troops and the forces at Mugua Plain in Shang Prefecture raced three hundred li in a day and night to Taohuabao; learning that the northern army was marching east from Fengyang, they turned east as well and joined the main army at Zhenping.

sentences.zh: 恆山公仙萬人元駐胡陵關，至是亦由荊子口、順陽來會。

translations.literal: Duke of Hengshan Xian's ten thousand men had originally been stationed at Huling Pass; by this time they also came to join by way of Jingzikou and Shunyang.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Hengshan Xian's ten thousand men had originally been stationed at Huling Pass; they now came to join by way of Jingzikou and Shunyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月朔，俱至鄧下，屯順陽。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month all arrived below Deng and encamped at Shunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month all reached the outskirts of Deng and encamped at Shunyang.

sentences.zh: 乃遣天山入宋。

translations.literal: They then sent Tianshan into Song territory.
translations.idiomatic: They then dispatched Liu Tianshan as envoy into Song territory.

sentences.zh: 初，宋人于國朝君之、伯之、叔之，納歲幣將百年。

translations.literal: Earlier the Song people had addressed our dynasty's rulers as lord, elder brother, and uncle, and paid annual tribute for nearly a hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: For nearly a century the Song had addressed our dynasty's rulers as lord, elder brother, and uncle and paid annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 南渡以後，宋以我為不足慮，絕不往來。

translations.literal: After the southern crossing the Song regarded us as not worth worrying about and cut off all contact.
translations.idiomatic: After the southern crossing the Song ceased to regard us as a threat and broke off all contact.

sentences.zh: 故宣宗南伐，士馬折耗十不一存，雖攻陷淮上數州，徒使驕將悍卒恣其殺虜、飽其私欲而已。

translations.literal: Therefore when Emperor Xuanzong campaigned south, soldiers and horses were depleted so that not one in ten remained; although several prefectures north of the Huai were taken, this only allowed arrogant generals and fierce soldiers to indulge in slaughter and captivity and satisfy their private desires.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong campaigned south, soldiers and horses were so depleted that scarcely one in ten survived; though several prefectures north of the Huai were taken, this only let arrogant generals and fierce soldiers indulge in slaughter and satisfy their private greed.

sentences.zh: 又宣徽使奧敦阿虎使北方，北中大臣有以輿地圖指示之曰：「商州至此中軍馬幾何？

translations.literal: Also, Palace Secretariat commissioner Aodun Ahu was sent on a mission to the north; a northern minister pointed to a map of territory and said: "From Shang Prefecture to here, how many soldiers and horses are in the middle?"
translations.idiomatic: Palace Secretariat commissioner Aodun Ahu was also sent on a mission north; a northern minister pointed to a territorial map and asked: "From Shang Prefecture to here, how many troops lie in between?"

sentences.zh: 」又指興元雲：「我不從商州，則取興元路入汝界矣。

translations.literal: He also pointed to Xingyuan and said: "If I do not come by Shang Prefecture, then I will take the Xingyuan route into your territory."
translations.idiomatic: He then pointed to Xingyuan and said: "If I do not come by Shang Prefecture, I will take the Xingyuan route into your territory."

sentences.zh: 」阿虎還奏，宣宗甚憂之。

translations.literal: Ahu returned and reported, and Emperor Xuanzong was deeply worried.
translations.idiomatic: When Ahu returned and reported this, Emperor Xuanzong was deeply alarmed.

sentences.zh: 哀宗即位，群臣建言，可因國喪遣使報哀，副以遺留物，因與之講解，盡撤邊備，共守武休之險。

translations.literal: When Emperor Aizong ascended the throne, the officials advised that one could take advantage of the national mourning to send envoys to announce the bereavement, accompany them with leftover goods, thereby negotiate a settlement, completely withdraw border defenses, and jointly hold the perilous pass at Wuxiu.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Aizong came to the throne, officials advised that the court could use the period of national mourning to send envoys announcing the bereavement, add gifts of leftover goods, negotiate a settlement with Song, withdraw border defenses, and jointly hold the perilous pass at Wuxiu.

sentences.zh: 遂下省院議之，而當國者有仰而不能俯之疾，皆以朝廷先遣人則於國體有虧為辭。

translations.literal: An order was then issued for the Secretariat and Censorate to deliberate, but those in power suffered from the ailment of being able to look up but not bow down; all used as their excuse that if the court sent envoys first it would damage national dignity.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the Secretariat and Censorate, but those in power were too proud to bend; all refused on the grounds that if the court sent envoys first it would damage national dignity.

sentences.zh: 元年，上諭南鄙諸帥，遣人往滁州與宋通好。

translations.literal: In year 1 the emperor instructed the commanders of the southern frontier to send men to Chuzhou to establish friendly relations with Song.
translations.idiomatic: In year 1 the emperor instructed the southern frontier commanders to send envoys to Chuzhou to open friendly relations with Song.

sentences.zh: 宋人每以奏稟為辭，和事遂不講。

translations.literal: The Song people each time used the need to memorialize and await approval as their excuse, and peace talks therefore never proceeded.
translations.idiomatic: The Song side each time pleaded the need to memorialize and await approval, and peace talks never got anywhere.

sentences.zh: 然十年之間，朝廷屢敕邊將不妄侵掠，彼我稍得休息，宋人始信之，遂有繼好之意。

translations.literal: Yet over ten years the court repeatedly ordered border generals not to raid recklessly; both sides gradually obtained rest; the Song people began to believe this and then had the intention of renewing friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: Over the next ten years the court repeatedly ordered border generals not to raid recklessly; both sides gradually gained a respite, the Song began to trust this, and the idea of renewing friendly relations took hold.

sentences.zh: 及天山以劄付至宋，劄付者指揮之別名，宋制使陳該怒辱天山，且以惡語複之。

translations.literal: When Tianshan arrived in Song with a zhafu—a zhafu being another name for a directive—the Song commissioner Chen Gai angrily insulted Tianshan and also replied with abusive language.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianshan arrived in Song with a directive—a zhafu being another name for a military order—Song commissioner Chen Gai angrily insulted him and replied with abusive language.

sentences.zh: 報至，識者皆為竊歎。

translations.literal: When the report arrived, those who understood the situation all sighed in private.
translations.idiomatic: When word of this reached home, those who understood the situation sighed in dismay.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，北兵渡漢江而北，諸將以為可乘其半渡擊之，蒲阿不從。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day the northern army crossed the Han River northward; the generals thought they could strike while the enemy was half across, but Pu'a would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day the northern army crossed the Han River heading north; the generals thought they could strike while the enemy was half across, but Pu'a refused.

sentences.zh: 丙子，兵畢渡，戰于禹山之前，北兵小卻，營於三十裏之外。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, after the troops had all crossed, they fought before Mount Yu; the northern army retreated slightly and encamped thirty li away.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, after the troops had all crossed, they fought before Mount Yu; the northern army fell back slightly and encamped thirty li away.

sentences.zh: 二相以大捷驛報，百官表賀，諸相置酒省中，左丞李蹊且喜且泣曰：「非今日之捷，生靈之禍，可勝言哉！

translations.literal: The two chief councilors reported a great victory by express post; the officials submitted congratulatory memorials; the chief councilors set out wine in the Secretariat; Left Assistant Chief Councilor Li Xi, both joyful and weeping, said: "If not for today's victory, the calamity to the people—how could it be told!"
translations.idiomatic: The two chief councilors reported a great victory by express courier; officials submitted congratulatory memorials; the chief councilors held a banquet in the Secretariat; Left Assistant Chief Councilor Li Xi, both joyful and in tears, said: "If not for today's victory, the calamity that would have befallen the people is beyond words!"

sentences.zh: 」蓋以為實然也。

translations.literal: They thought it was indeed so.
translations.idiomatic: They believed it was truly so.

sentences.zh: 先是，河南聞北兵出饒峰，百姓往往入城壁、保險固，及聞敵已退，至有晏然不動者，不二三日遊騎至，人無所逃，悉為捷書所誤。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Henan heard that the northern army had come out through Raofeng, the common people often entered walled cities and held secure strongpoints; when they heard the enemy had withdrawn, some even remained calmly unmoved; within two or three days roaming cavalry arrived, people had nowhere to flee, and all were deceived by the victory reports.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Henan heard the northern army had come through Raofeng Pass, people fled into walled cities and fortified strongpoints; when word came that the enemy had withdrawn, some even stayed calmly in place; within two or three days roaming cavalry arrived, people had nowhere to flee, and all had been misled by the victory reports.

sentences.zh: 九年正月丁酉，兩省軍潰于陽翟之三峰山。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 9, on the dingyou day, the armies of the two branch secretariats were routed at Three Peak Mountain in Yangzhai.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the first month of year 9, the armies of both branch secretariats were routed at Three Peak Mountain in Yangzhai.

sentences.zh: 初，禹山之戰，兩軍相拒，北軍散漫而北，金軍懼其乘虛襲京城，乃謀入援。

translations.literal: Initially, at the battle of Mount Yu the two armies faced each other; the northern army spread out and marched north; the Jin army feared they would seize an opening to strike the capital and therefore planned to enter and reinforce it.
translations.idiomatic: At the battle of Mount Yu the two armies faced off; the northern army spread out and marched north; the Jin army feared they would exploit an opening to strike the capital and planned to march east to reinforce it.

sentences.zh: 時北兵遣三千騎趨河上，已二十餘日，泌陽、南陽、方城、襄、郟至京諸縣皆破，所有積聚焚毀無餘。

translations.literal: At the time the northern army had sent three thousand cavalry toward the river; for more than twenty days already Biyang, Nanyang, Fangcheng, Xiang, Jia, and all the counties on the route to the capital had fallen; all stored goods were burned and destroyed without remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The northern army had already sent three thousand cavalry toward the river for more than twenty days; Biyang, Nanyang, Fangcheng, Xiang, Jia, and all the counties on the route to the capital had fallen, and all stored supplies had been burned without remainder.

sentences.zh: 金軍由鄧而東，無所仰給，乃並山入陽翟。

translations.literal: The Jin army went east from Deng with nothing to rely on for supplies and therefore entered Yangzhai along the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin army marched east from Deng with no supplies to draw on and entered Yangzhai along the mountain route.

sentences.zh: 既行，北兵即襲之，且行且戰，北兵傷折亦多。

translations.literal: Once they set out the northern army immediately attacked them; they marched and fought as they went, and the northern army also suffered many casualties.
translations.idiomatic: Once they set out the northern army immediately attacked; they fought as they marched, and the northern army also took heavy losses.

sentences.zh: 恆山一軍為突騎三千所沖，軍殊死鬥，北騎退走。

translations.literal: The Hengshan army was charged by three thousand shock cavalry; the army fought to the death, and the northern cavalry retreated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Hengshan army was charged by three thousand shock cavalry; the men fought to the death and drove the northern horsemen back.

sentences.zh: 追奔之際，忽大霧四塞，兩省命收軍。

translations.literal: In the midst of the pursuit, suddenly thick fog closed in on all sides, and the two branch secretariats ordered the army to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: In the midst of the pursuit a thick fog suddenly closed in on all sides, and both branch secretariats ordered a halt.

sentences.zh: 少之，霧散乃前，前一大澗，長闊數裏，非此霧則北兵人馬滿中矣。

translations.literal: After a short while the fog cleared and they advanced; ahead was a great ravine several li long and wide; if not for this fog the northern army's men and horses would have filled it.
translations.idiomatic: After a short while the fog cleared and they advanced; ahead lay a great ravine several li long and wide—without that fog the northern army's men and horses would have filled it completely.

sentences.zh: 明日，至三峰山，遂潰，事載蒲阿傳。

translations.literal: The next day they reached Three Peak Mountain and were then routed; the affair is recorded in Pu'a's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they reached Three Peak Mountain and were routed; the full account is given in Pu'a's biography.

sentences.zh: 合達知大事已去，欲下馬戰，而蒲阿已失所在。

translations.literal: Heda knew the great cause was lost, wished to dismount and fight, but Pu'a had already disappeared.
translations.idiomatic: Heda knew the cause was lost and wanted to dismount and fight to the death, but Pu'a had already vanished.

sentences.zh: 合達以數百騎走鈞州，北兵塹其城外攻之，走門不得出，匿窟室中，城破，北兵發而殺之。

translations.literal: Heda fled with several hundred cavalry to Jun Prefecture; the northern army dug trenches outside the city and attacked; he tried to flee through the gate but could not get out, hid in a cave-room, and when the city fell the northern army dug him out and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Heda fled with several hundred cavalry to Jun Prefecture; the northern army dug trenches outside the city and attacked; he tried to flee through the gate but could not escape, hid in a cave-room, and when the city fell the northern army dug him out and killed him.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷不知其死，或雲已走京兆，賜以手詔，募人訪之。

translations.literal: At the time the court did not know he was dead; some said he had fled to Jingzhao; an imperial handwritten edict was granted and men were recruited to search for him.
translations.idiomatic: The court did not yet know he was dead; some said he had fled to Jingzhao; the emperor issued a handwritten edict and sent men to search for him.

sentences.zh: 及攻汴，乃揚言曰：「汝家所恃，惟黃河與合達耳。

translations.literal: When they attacked Bian they then proclaimed loudly: "What your house relies on is only the Yellow River and Heda."
translations.idiomatic: When they besieged Bian they proclaimed: "Your house relies on only two things—the Yellow River and Heda."

sentences.zh: 今合達為我殺，黃河為我有，不降何待？」

translations.literal: Now Heda has been killed by us, the Yellow River is ours—why not surrender, what are you waiting for?"
translations.idiomatic: Heda is dead at our hands and the Yellow River is ours—why not surrender? What are you waiting for?"

sentences.zh: 合達熟知敵情，習於行陣，且重義輕財，與下同甘苦，有俘獲即分給，遇敵則身先之而不避，眾亦樂為之用，其為人亦可知矣。

translations.literal: Heda thoroughly knew enemy conditions, was practiced in battle formations, valued righteousness and treated wealth lightly, shared hardship and comfort with his men, immediately distributed any captives taken, and when encountering the enemy went ahead in person without avoiding danger; the troops also gladly served him—his character can thus be known.
translations.idiomatic: Heda knew the enemy well, was skilled in battle, valued honor over wealth, shared hardship with his men, distributed booty immediately, and always led from the front without flinching; his troops gladly followed him—his character speaks for itself.

sentences.zh: 左丞張行信嘗薦之曰：「完顏合達，今之良將也。」

translations.literal: Left Assistant Chief Councilor Zhang Xingxin once recommended him saying: "Wanyan Heda is a fine general of our time."
translations.idiomatic: Left Assistant Chief Councilor Zhang Xingxin once recommended him: "Wanyan Heda is the finest general of our time."

sentences.zh: 移剌蒲阿

translations.literal: Yila Pu'a
translations.idiomatic: Biography: Yi Lapua

sentences.zh: 正大四年十二月，河朔軍突入商州，殘硃陽、盧氏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of Zhengda 4 the armies north of the Yellow River suddenly entered Shang Prefecture and ravaged Zhuyang and Lushi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Zhengda 4 armies from north of the Yellow River suddenly entered Shang Prefecture and ravaged Zhuyang and Lushi.

sentences.zh: 蒲阿逆戰至靈寶東，遇游騎十餘，獲一人，餘即退，蒲阿輒以捷聞。

translations.literal: Pu'a marched out to meet them and fought east to Lingbao; he encountered more than ten roaming cavalry, captured one man, and the rest immediately withdrew; Pu'a promptly reported a victory.
translations.idiomatic: Pu'a marched out to meet them and fought as far east as Lingbao; he encountered a dozen roaming horsemen, captured one man, and the rest withdrew at once; Pu'a promptly reported a victory.

sentences.zh: 賞世襲謀克，仍厚賜之。

translations.literal: He was rewarded with a hereditary company commandership and also generously gifted.
translations.idiomatic: He was rewarded with a hereditary company commandership and generous gifts.

sentences.zh: 人共知其罔上，而無敢言，吏部郎中楊居仁以微言取怒。

translations.literal: People all knew he was deceiving the throne, but none dared speak; Ministry of Personnel bureau director Yang Juren incurred anger with a subtle remark.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone knew he was deceiving the throne, but none dared speak out; Ministry of Personnel bureau director Yang Juren drew anger with a subtle remark.

sentences.zh: 六年二月丙辰，以蒲阿權樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 6, on the bingchen day, Pu'a was made acting vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the second month of year 6 Pu'a was made acting vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 自去年夏，北軍之在陝西者駸駸至涇州，且阻慶陽糧道。

translations.literal: Since last summer the northern army in Shaanxi had pressed on steadily to Jing Prefecture and also blocked the grain route to Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Since the previous summer the northern army in Shaanxi had pressed steadily toward Jing Prefecture and blocked the grain route to Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 蒲阿奏：「陝西設兩行省，本以籓衛河南，今北軍之來三年於茲，行省統軍馬二三十萬，未嘗對壘，亦未嘗得一折箭，何用行省。

translations.literal: Pu'a memorialized: "Shaanxi was given two branch secretariats originally to shield and defend Henan; now the northern army has been coming for three years; the branch secretariats command two or three hundred thousand troops and horses, yet have never faced the enemy in battle and never broken a single arrow—what use are branch secretariats?"
translations.idiomatic: Pu'a memorialized: "Shaanxi was given two branch secretariats to shield Henan; the northern army has been coming for three years now, and those branch secretariats command two or three hundred thousand troops yet have never faced the enemy in battle or broken a single arrow—what use are they?"

sentences.zh: 」院官亦俱奏將來須用密院軍馬勾當，上不語者久之。

translations.literal: The Bureau officials also all memorialized that in the future the secretariat bureau's troops and horses would need to be deployed; the emperor was silent for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau officials also memorialized that the secretariat bureau's troops would need to be deployed going forward; the emperor was silent for a long time.

sentences.zh: 是後，以丞相賽不行尚書省事於關中，召平章政事合達還朝，白撒亦召至闕，蒲阿率完顏陳和尚忠孝軍一千駐邠州，且令觀北勢。

translations.literal: After this, Chief Councilor Sai Bu was sent to handle Secretariat affairs in Guanzhong; Chief Councilor Heda was recalled to court; Ba Sa was also summoned to the palace; Pu'a led Wanyan Chen Heshang with one thousand Zhongxiao Army troops to garrison Bin Prefecture and was also ordered to observe northern conditions.
translations.idiomatic: After this Chief Councilor Sai Bu was sent to handle Secretariat affairs in Guanzhong, Chief Councilor Heda was recalled to court, Ba Sa was summoned to the palace, and Pu'a led Wanyan Chen Heshang with one thousand Zhongxiao Army troops to garrison Bin Prefecture and observe northern movements.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，蒲阿再複潞州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the bingshen day, Pu'a again recovered Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the eighth month Pu'a retook Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未朔，蒲阿東還。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month, the yiwei day, Pu'a returned east.
translations.idiomatic: On the first yiwei day of the tenth month Pu'a returned east.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，詔蒲阿與總帥牙吾塔、權簽樞密院事訛可救慶陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the yiwei day, an edict ordered Pu'a together with overall commander Yawuta and acting signer of the Bureau of Military Affairs Eke to relieve Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the twelfth month an edict ordered Pu'a, overall commander Yawuta, and acting signer of the Bureau of Military Affairs Eke to relieve Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，戰北兵于大昌原，北軍還，慶陽圍解。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 7 they fought the northern army at Dachangyuan; the northern army withdrew and the siege of Qingyang was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year seven they fought the northern army at Dachangyuan; the enemy withdrew and the siege of Qingyang was lifted.

sentences.zh: 詔以訛可屯邠州，蒲阿、牙吾塔還京兆。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Eke to garrison Bin Prefecture, and Pu'a and Yawuta to return to Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Eke to garrison Bin Prefecture while Pu'a and Yawuta returned to Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以權參知政事與合達行省於閿鄉。

translations.literal: Before long he was made acting participant in the administration of the Secretariat and together with Heda conducted branch secretariat affairs at Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made acting participant in the Secretariat and joined Heda in handling branch secretariat affairs at Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，北軍入陝西，鳳翔破，兩行省棄京兆而東，至洛陽驛，被召議河中事，語在白華傳。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 8 the northern army entered Shaanxi; Fengxiang fell; the two branch secretariats abandoned Jingzhao and went east; at Luoyang post station they were summoned to deliberate on Hezhong affairs—the account is in Bai Hua's biography.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 8 the northern army entered Shaanxi, Fengxiang fell, and the two branch secretariats abandoned Jingzhao and marched east; at Luoyang post station they were summoned to debate the Hezhong situation—the account is given in Bai Hua's biography.

sentences.zh: 十二月，北兵濟自漢江，兩省軍入鄧州，議敵所從出，謂由光化截江戰為便，放之渡而戰為便、張惠以「截江為便，縱之渡，我腹空虛，能不為所潰乎？

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the northern army crossed from the Han River; the armies of the two branch secretariats entered Deng Prefecture and debated where the enemy would come from; some said intercepting them at the river at Guanghua would be best, others said letting them cross and then fighting would be best; Zhang Hui said: "Intercepting at the river is best—if we let them cross, our interior is empty; can we avoid being routed?"
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the northern army crossed the Han River; both branch secretariats entered Deng Prefecture and debated how to meet the enemy; some favored intercepting them at Guanghua on the river, others favored letting them cross and then fighting; Zhang Hui argued: "Intercept at the river—if we let them cross, our rear is empty; how can we avoid being routed?"

sentences.zh: 」蒲阿麾之曰：「汝但知南事，于北事何知。

translations.literal: Pu'a waved him off and said: "You only know southern affairs—what do you know of northern affairs?"
translations.idiomatic: Pu'a waved him off: "You only know southern affairs—what do you know of the north?"

sentences.zh: 我向於裕州得制旨雲，'使彼在沙磧，且當往求之'，況今自來乎。

translations.literal: I once received an imperial directive at Yu Prefecture saying, 'If they are in the desert sands, one should still go seek them out'—how much more so now that they have come of their own accord.
translations.idiomatic: I once received an imperial directive at Yu Prefecture saying, 'Even if they are in the desert sands, one should still go seek them out'—how much more so now that they have come of their own accord.

sentences.zh: 汝等更勿似大昌原、舊衛州、扇車回縱出之。

translations.literal: You must not again do as at Dachangyuan, old Weizhou, and Shanche Pass—letting them escape.
translations.idiomatic: Do not repeat what happened at Dachangyuan, old Weizhou, and Shanche Pass—letting them escape.

sentences.zh: 」定住、高、樊皆謂蒲阿此言為然。

translations.literal: Dingzhu, Gao, and Fan all said Pu'a's words were correct.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhu, Gao, and Fan all agreed with Pu'a.

sentences.zh: 合達乃問按得木，木以為不然。

translations.literal: Heda then asked Andemu, and Mu thought otherwise.
translations.idiomatic: Heda then asked Andemu, who disagreed.

sentences.zh: 軍中以木北人，知其軍情，此言為有理，然不能奪蒲阿之議。

translations.literal: In the army, because Mu was a northerner and knew their military conditions, they considered this view reasonable, yet they could not overturn Pu'a's decision.
translations.idiomatic: Because Andemu was a northerner who knew the enemy's ways, many in the army thought his view made sense, yet they could not overturn Pu'a's decision.

sentences.zh: 順陽留二十日，光化探騎至，雲「千騎已北渡」，兩省是夜進軍，比曉至禹山，探者續雲「北騎已盡濟」。

translations.literal: They remained at Shunyang for twenty days; reconnaissance cavalry from Guanghua arrived saying "a thousand cavalry have already crossed north"; that night the two branch secretariats advanced; by dawn they reached Mount Yu; scouts further reported "the northern cavalry have all crossed."
translations.idiomatic: They remained at Shunyang for twenty days; reconnaissance from Guanghua reported that a thousand cavalry had already crossed north; that night both branch secretariats advanced, and by dawn they reached Mount Yu, where scouts reported that the northern cavalry had all finished crossing.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，北軍將近，兩省立軍高山，各分據地勢，步迎於山前，騎屯於山后。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, as the northern army drew near, the two branch secretariats deployed on the high mountain, each occupying terrain according to position; infantry met them before the mountain, cavalry encamped behind the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, as the northern army drew near, both branch secretariats deployed on the high ground, each taking position according to the terrain; infantry formed up before the mountain and cavalry encamped behind it.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，日未出，北兵至，大帥以兩小旗前導來觀，觀竟不前，散如雁翅，轉山麓出騎兵之後，分三隊而進，輜重外余二萬人。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, before the sun rose, the northern army arrived; the great commander came forward with two small flags as guides to observe; after observing he did not advance, spread out like goose wings, turned along the mountain foot to emerge behind the cavalry, divided into three columns and advanced—aside from baggage, more than twenty thousand men remained.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, before sunrise, the northern army arrived; the great commander came forward under two small guide flags to reconnoiter, then did not advance but spread out like geese in flight, swung along the mountain foot to emerge behind the Jin cavalry, and advanced in three columns—aside from baggage trains, more than twenty thousand men remained.

sentences.zh: 合達令諸軍，「觀今日事勢，不當戰，且待之。

translations.literal: Heda ordered the armies: "Observing today's situation, we should not fight—wait for now."
translations.idiomatic: Heda ordered the armies: "Given today's situation we should not fight—wait for now."

sentences.zh: 」俄而北騎突前，金兵不得不戰，至以短兵相接，戰三交，北騎少退。

translations.literal: Before long northern cavalry charged forward; the Jin troops could not avoid fighting; they came to close combat; after three exchanges the northern cavalry retreated slightly.
translations.idiomatic: Before long northern cavalry charged forward and the Jin troops had no choice but to fight; they closed to hand-to-hand combat, exchanged three rounds, and the northern cavalry fell back slightly.

sentences.zh: 北兵之在西者望蒲阿親繞甲騎後而突之，至於三，為蒲察定住力拒而退。

translations.literal: The northern troops on the west side saw Pu'a personally circle behind the armored cavalry and charge; this happened three times, and each time Pucha Dingzhu forcefully resisted and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Northern troops on the west saw Pu'a personally circle behind the armored cavalry and charge; this happened three times, and each time Pucha Dingzhu forcefully repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 大帥以旗聚諸將，議良久。

translations.literal: The great commander gathered the generals with his flag and deliberated for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: The great commander gathered the generals under his banner and deliberated for a long time.

sentences.zh: 合達知北兵意向。

translations.literal: Heda knew the northern army's intention.
translations.idiomatic: Heda understood the northern army's intention.

sentences.zh: 時高英軍方北顧，而北兵出其背擁之，英軍動，合達幾斬英，英複督軍力戰。

translations.literal: At the time Gao Ying's army was just looking north when northern troops emerged from behind and pressed them; Ying's army wavered; Heda nearly executed Ying; Ying again urged his army to fight hard.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Ying's army was looking north when northern troops emerged from behind and pressed them; Ying's line wavered and Heda nearly had him executed; Ying rallied his men and fought on.

sentences.zh: 北兵稍卻觀變，英軍定，複擁樊澤軍，合達斬一千夫長，軍殊死鬥，乃卻之。

translations.literal: The northern army retreated slightly to observe the change; Ying's army steadied; they again pressed Fan Ze's army; Heda beheaded a chiliarch; the army fought to the death and only then drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: The northern army fell back slightly to watch developments; Ying's line held; they then pressed Fan Ze's army; Heda beheaded a chiliarch; the men fought to the death and finally drove the enemy back.

sentences.zh: 北兵回陣，南向來路。

translations.literal: The northern army returned to formation and faced south toward their route of advance.
translations.idiomatic: The northern army reformed and faced south toward their line of march.

sentences.zh: 兩省復議：「彼雖號三萬，而輜重三之一焉。

translations.literal: The two branch secretariats deliberated again: "Though they claim thirty thousand, one third are baggage troops."
translations.idiomatic: Both branch secretariats debated again: "Though they claim thirty thousand men, a third are baggage troops."

sentences.zh: 又相持二三日不得食，乘其卻退當擁之。

translations.literal: Moreover, after two or three days without food in the standoff, we should press them as they retreat.
translations.idiomatic: After two or three days without food in the standoff, we should press them as they withdraw.

sentences.zh: 」張惠主此議，蒲阿言：「江路已絕，黃河不冰，彼入重地，將安歸乎？

translations.literal: Zhang Hui advocated this view; Pu'a said: "The river route is cut off, the Yellow River is not frozen—they have entered deep territory; where can they return?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hui favored this plan; Pu'a said: "The river route is cut off and the Yellow River is not frozen—they are deep in hostile territory; where can they go?

sentences.zh: 何以速為。

translations.literal: Why act in haste?
translations.idiomatic: Why act in haste?"

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: They did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The court would not accept this.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，北兵忽不知所在，營火寂無一耗。

translations.literal: On the yihai day the northern army suddenly could not be found anywhere; campfires were silent without a single sign.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day the northern army suddenly vanished; not a single campfire remained.

sentences.zh: 兩省及諸將議，四日不見軍，又不見營，鄧州津送及路人不絕，而亦無見者，豈南渡而歸乎？

translations.literal: The two branch secretariats and the generals deliberated: for four days they saw neither army nor camp; ferry traffic and travelers from Deng Prefecture continued without cease, yet none had seen them—had they crossed south and returned?
translations.idiomatic: Both branch secretariats and the generals debated: for four days they saw neither army nor camp; ferry traffic and travelers from Deng Prefecture continued unbroken, yet no one had seen them—had they crossed south and withdrawn?

sentences.zh: 己卯，邏騎乃知北軍在光化對岸棗林中，晝作食，夜不下馬，望林中往來，不五六十步而不聞音響，其有謀可知矣。

translations.literal: On the jimao day patrol cavalry finally learned the northern army was in the jujube grove on the opposite bank at Guanghua; they cooked by day and did not dismount at night; looking toward the grove as men moved back and forth, within fifty or sixty paces not a sound was heard—their scheming could thus be known.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day patrol cavalry finally found the northern army in the jujube grove on the Guanghua opposite bank; they cooked by day and slept in the saddle at night; watching the grove from fifty or sixty paces away, not a sound could be heard—their deception was plain.

sentences.zh: 初，禹山戰罷，有二騎迷入營，問之，知北兵凡七頭項，大將統之。

translations.literal: Initially, after the battle at Mount Yu ended, two horsemen lost their way and wandered into camp; upon questioning, it was learned the northern army had seven command groups in all, each under a great general.
translations.idiomatic: After the battle at Mount Yu, two horsemen lost their way and wandered into camp; from them it was learned that the northern army had seven command groups, each under a great general.

sentences.zh: 複有詐降者十人，弊衣羸馬泣訴艱苦，兩省信之，易以肥馬，飲之酒，及暖衣食而置之陣後，十人者皆鞭馬而去，始悟其為覘騎也。

translations.literal: Also there were ten men who feigned surrender, in ragged clothes on emaciated horses weeping and complaining of hardship; the two branch secretariats believed them, exchanged their horses for fat ones, gave them wine, warmed them with food and clothing and placed them behind the battle line; the ten men all whipped their horses and fled—it was then understood they were reconnaissance cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Ten men also feigned surrender, in ragged clothes on emaciated horses weeping of hardship; both branch secretariats believed them, gave them fresh horses, wine, warm food and clothing, and placed them behind the line; all ten whipped their horses and fled—it was then understood they were enemy scouts.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，兩省議入鄧就糧，辰巳間到林後，北兵忽來突，兩省軍迎擊，交綏之際，北兵以百騎邀輜重而去，金兵幾不成列，逮夜乃入城，懼軍士迷路，鳴鐘招之。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day the two branch secretariats deliberated on entering Deng for provisions; between chen and si hours they reached behind the grove; the northern army suddenly came in a rush; the armies of the two branch secretariats met them in attack; in the midst of the skirmish the northern army used a hundred cavalry to intercept baggage and departed; the Jin troops nearly lost formation; only at night did they enter the city; fearing soldiers would lose their way, they rang bells to summon them.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day both branch secretariats decided to enter Deng for provisions; between mid-morning and noon they reached the far side of the grove; the northern army suddenly attacked; both armies met them in battle; in the skirmish a hundred northern horsemen seized the baggage train and withdrew; the Jin troops nearly lost formation and only entered the city at night; fearing soldiers would lose their way, they rang bells to gather them.

sentences.zh: 樊澤屯城西，高英屯城東。

translations.literal: Fan Ze encamped west of the city, Gao Ying east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ze encamped west of the city and Gao Ying east of it.

sentences.zh: 九年正月壬午朔，耀兵于鄧城下。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of year 9, the renwu day, they displayed their army below Deng city.
translations.idiomatic: On the first renwu day of the first month of year 9 they paraded their army before Deng city.

sentences.zh: 北兵不與戰，大將使來索酒，兩省與之二十瓶。

translations.literal: The northern army would not fight; the great general sent someone to request wine; the two branch secretariats gave them twenty bottles.
translations.idiomatic: The northern army would not fight; the great general sent an envoy to request wine, and both branch secretariats gave him twenty bottles.

sentences.zh: 癸未，大軍發鄧州，趨京師，騎二萬，步十三萬，騎帥蒲察定住，蒲察答吉卜，郎將按忒木，忠孝軍總領夾穀愛答、內族達魯歡，總領夾穀移特剌，提控步軍臨淄郡王張惠，殄寇都尉完顏阿排、高英、樊澤，中軍陳和尚，與恆山公武仙、楊沃衍軍合。

translations.literal: On the guimao day the great army set out from Deng Prefecture toward the capital: twenty thousand cavalry, one hundred thirty thousand infantry; cavalry commanders Pucha Dingzhu, Pucha Dajibu, and commandant Andemu; Zhongxiao Army overall leaders Jiagu Aida and imperial clansman Daluhuan; overall leader Jiagu Yitelie; infantry army controller Linzi Prince Zhang Hui; extermination bandit commandants Wanyan Apai, Gao Ying, and Fan Ze; center army Chen Heshang—joined with Duke of Hengshan Wuxian and Yang Woyan's armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the great army set out from Deng Prefecture for the capital: twenty thousand cavalry and one hundred thirty thousand infantry; cavalry under Pucha Dingzhu, Pucha Dajibu, and commandant Andemu; Zhongxiao Army under overall leaders Jiagu Aida and imperial clansman Daluhuan; overall leader Jiagu Yitelie; infantry under army controller Linzi Prince Zhang Hui; extermination bandit commandants Wanyan Apai, Gao Ying, and Fan Ze; center army under Chen Heshang—joined with Duke of Hengshan Wuxian and Yang Woyan's forces.

sentences.zh: 是日，次五朵山下，取鴉路，北兵以三千騎尾之，遂駐營待楊武。

translations.literal: That day they halted below Five Peak Mountain, took the Crow Route; the northern army followed with three thousand cavalry; they then encamped and waited for Yang and Wu.
translations.idiomatic: That day they halted below Five Peak Mountain and took the Crow Route; three thousand northern cavalry followed them, and they encamped to wait for Yang and Wu.

sentences.zh: 楊武至，知申、裕兩州已降。

translations.literal: When Yang and Wu arrived, they learned Shen and Yu prefectures had already surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang and Wu arrived, they learned that Shen and Yu prefectures had already surrendered.

sentences.zh: 七日至夜，議北騎明日當複襲我，彼止騎三千，而我示以弱，將為所輕，當與之戰。

translations.literal: On the seventh day at night they deliberated that the northern cavalry would attack again the next day; they had only three thousand horsemen, yet if we showed weakness we would be despised—we should fight them.
translations.idiomatic: On the evening of the seventh day they debated that the northern cavalry would attack again the next day; the enemy had only three thousand horsemen, but if the Jin showed weakness they would be held in contempt—a fight was necessary.

sentences.zh: 乃伏騎五十于鄧州道。

translations.literal: They then hid fifty cavalry on the Deng Prefecture road.
translations.idiomatic: They then hid fifty cavalry along the Deng Prefecture road.

sentences.zh: 明日軍行，北騎襲之如故，金以萬人擁之而東，伏發，北兵南避。

translations.literal: The next day as the army marched the northern cavalry attacked as before; the Jin used ten thousand men to press them eastward; the ambush was sprung and the northern army fled south.
translations.idiomatic: The next day as the army marched the northern cavalry attacked as before; the Jin sent ten thousand men to press them eastward; the ambush was sprung and the northern army fled south.

sentences.zh: 是日雨，宿竹林中。

translations.literal: That day it rained and they lodged in a bamboo grove.
translations.idiomatic: It rained that day and they camped in a bamboo grove.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，頓安皋。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day they halted at Angao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin they made camp at Angao.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，宿鴉路、魯山。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day they lodged at the Crow Route and Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day they camped at the Crow Route and Lushan.

sentences.zh: 河西軍已獻申、裕，擁老幼牛羊取鴉路，金軍適值之，奪其牛羊餉軍。

translations.literal: The Hexi army had already surrendered Shen and Yu, driving old and young with cattle and sheep along the Crow Route; the Jin army happened upon them and seized their cattle and sheep to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexi army had already surrendered Shen and Yu and was driving old and young with cattle and sheep along the Crow Route; the Jin army happened upon them and seized the livestock to feed the troops.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，望鈞州，至沙河，北騎五千待于河北，金軍奪橋以過，北軍即西首斂避。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, sighting Jun Prefecture, they reached the Sha River; five thousand northern cavalry waited on the north bank; the Jin army seized the bridge to cross; the northern army immediately turned west and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, with Jun Prefecture in sight, they reached the Sha River; five thousand northern cavalry waited on the north bank; the Jin army seized the bridge to cross, and the northern army immediately turned west and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 金軍縱擊，北軍不戰，複南渡沙河。

translations.literal: The Jin army pressed the attack; the northern army would not fight and again crossed the Sha River southward.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin army pressed the attack; the northern army would not fight and crossed the Sha River southward again.

sentences.zh: 金軍欲盤營，北軍複渡河來襲。

translations.literal: The Jin army wished to encamp; the northern army again crossed the river to attack.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin army tried to make camp, but the northern army crossed the river again to attack.

sentences.zh: 金軍不能得食，又不得休息。

translations.literal: The Jin army could obtain no food and also could not rest.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin army could get no food and no rest.

sentences.zh: 合昏，雨作，明旦變雪。

translations.literal: At dusk rain fell; by the next morning it had turned to snow.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk rain began to fall; by the next morning it had turned to snow.

sentences.zh: 北兵增及萬人，且行且戰，致黃榆店，望鈞州二十五裏，雨雪不能進，盤營三日。

translations.literal: The northern army increased to ten thousand men; they marched and fought as they went, reaching Huangyudian; twenty-five li from Jun Prefecture, rain and snow prevented advance, and they encamped for three days.
translations.idiomatic: The northern army grew to ten thousand men; they fought as they marched to Huangyudian, twenty-five li from Jun Prefecture; rain and snow halted their advance and they encamped for three days.

sentences.zh: 丙申，一近侍入軍中傳旨，集諸帥聽處分，制旨雲：「兩省軍悉赴京師，我禦門犒軍，換易禦馬，然後出戰未晚。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day a palace attendant entered the army to transmit an edict, gathering the commanders to hear disposition; the imperial directive said: "The armies of the two branch secretariats shall all proceed to the capital; I will reward the army at the palace gate, exchange imperial horses, and then going out to battle will not be too late."
